verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Managing and tracking cloud coding-agent tasks from a phone belongs to coding-agent platforms, so this story is a category error for it. The evidence comes close but does not show the capability: Aperture is an LLM gateway whose CLI runs coding agents, and iPad or phone access to remote environments is only connectivity. Neither is a task management or tracking interface, so the exception for wrong-axis products does not apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
